title: 我住在一颗星星旁边
subtitle: 太阳也是一颗星星
negative: character sheet, model sheet, multiple views, grid, collage, text, watermark, signature, blurry, deformed hands, extra fingers, photorealistic face, photorealistic, busy detail, harsh contrast

pages.zh:
晚上，我躺在草地上看天。
星星好多好多，
小小的，一闪一闪。
pages.prompt: ohwx boy, wearing a dark blue long sleeve shirt and grey trousers, short black hair, children's picture book illustration, retro screenprint poster style, limited palette of deep navy teal and warm orange, flat simple shapes, subtle paper grain, A little boy lying on his back on grass at night looking up, seen from above, the whole sky above him filled with small stars, deep navy tones, flat graphic style.

pages.zh:
我说：「星星好小。」
爸爸说：
「不是小。
是远。」
pages.prompt: ohwx boy, wearing a dark blue long sleeve shirt and grey trousers, short black hair, children's picture book illustration, retro screenprint poster style, limited palette of deep navy teal and warm orange, flat simple shapes, subtle paper grain, A little boy and his father lying side by side on grass at night, both pointing up at the stars, drawn small inside a large starry frame.

pages.zh:
星星其实很大很大。
大得像太阳一样。
因为太远太远了，
看起来才只有一点点。
pages.prompt: children's picture book illustration, retro screenprint poster style, limited palette of deep navy teal and warm orange, flat simple shapes, subtle paper grain, A comparison picture: an enormous glowing star filling the left half of the frame, and the same star shown as a tiny dot far away on the right, dark sky between them, flat screenprint shapes.

pages.zh:
那太阳呢？
太阳也是一颗「星星」。
只是它离我们最近，
所以又大又亮。
pages.prompt: children's picture book illustration, retro screenprint poster style, limited palette of deep navy teal and warm orange, flat simple shapes, subtle paper grain, The sun drawn as one star among many: a large warm glowing sun on one side and many smaller stars of the same kind scattered across the dark sky, simple flat shapes.

pages.zh:
白天的时候，
星星还在天上吗？
在的。
只是太阳太亮了，
把它们盖住了。
pages.prompt: children's picture book illustration, retro screenprint poster style, limited palette of deep navy teal and warm orange, flat simple shapes, subtle paper grain, A bright blue daytime sky in full midday daylight above a simple green field, the sun high and warm, and a scattering of very faint pale stars still drawn softly across the blue daytime sky to show that they are still there
pages.negative_extra: sunset, dusk, twilight, evening, night, dark sky, orange horizon, silhouette, person, figure

pages.zh:
月亮不一样。
月亮自己不发光。
是太阳照亮了它，
像照亮一面镜子。
pages.prompt: children's picture book illustration, retro screenprint poster style, limited palette of deep navy teal and warm orange, flat simple shapes, subtle paper grain, The moon alone in a dark night sky, sunlight arriving from one side so that half of its surface is bright and the other half falls into soft shadow, a plain round moon with a few simple craters, several small stars around it
pages.negative_extra: face, eyes, eyelashes, mouth, nose, smiling moon, man in the moon, cartoon character, anthropomorphic

pages.zh:
那我们呢？
我们住的地球，
也在天上飞。
绕着太阳，
一圈，又一圈。
pages.prompt: children's picture book illustration, retro screenprint poster style, limited palette of deep navy teal and warm orange, flat simple shapes, subtle paper grain, A warm orange sun at the centre of the picture and a small blue Earth further out to one side, with a simple thin dotted oval line drawn around the sun to show the path the Earth travels along, dark space and a few small stars
pages.negative_extra: rings around planet, ringed planet, saturn, ribbon, road, band, thick solid curve, stick, connecting rod, straight line between objects

pages.zh:
如果从很远的地方看，
地球也只是一个小亮点。
小小的，
蓝蓝的。
pages.prompt: children's picture book illustration, retro screenprint poster style, limited palette of deep navy teal and warm orange, flat simple shapes, subtle paper grain, The Earth seen from very far away as one small pale blue dot in dark empty space, tiny and quiet, a great deal of empty space around it.

pages.zh:
所以我不用坐火箭去太空。
我已经在太空里了。
我一直都在。
pages.prompt: ohwx boy, wearing a dark blue long sleeve shirt and grey trousers, short black hair, children's picture book illustration, retro screenprint poster style, limited palette of deep navy teal and warm orange, flat simple shapes, subtle paper grain, A little boy standing on grass at night with his arms out, the ground beneath him curving away like the surface of a planet, stars all around him, flat graphic style.

pages.zh:
我躺在草地上，
抱着这颗会飞的大球，
和满天的星星一起，
转啊，转啊。
pages.prompt: ohwx boy, wearing a dark blue long sleeve shirt and grey trousers, short black hair, children's picture book illustration, retro screenprint poster style, limited palette of deep navy teal and warm orange, flat simple shapes, subtle paper grain, A little boy lying on grass at night seen from directly above with arms spread, boy and grass small at the centre of a huge sky full of stars, calm and wide.
